//: SPAWN POLICY, PART 1 of 2: the 'primary' marker effect.  Exactly one live SCP-173 should carry this at a time.  The sweep below grants it to the first instance it finds and retires every other instance that lacks it.  This is what enforces 'only one SCP-173 in the world' - CDDA has no unique_id for monsters (src/game.h:1187 is NPC-only), so the invariant has to be maintained rather than declared.
name: SCP-173
desc: This is the original.  The others are not.

//: SPAWN POLICY, PART 2 of 2: the quota sweep.  Runs every 10 minutes, world-scoped.  It resets a claim counter and then dispatches a per-monster EOC to every SCP-173 in range.  Monster ids are matched with mtype_ids, and 'global': true keeps the claim counter visible across the whole sweep.  TO POLICE A NEW SCP: copy these two EOCs with the new id and change the mtype_ids entry.  Nothing else needs editing.

effect.//: No instance has claimed primary status yet this sweep.

//: Runs once per nearby SCP-173 (alpha is that monster).  The first claimant becomes the primary and keeps its marker.  Any other instance is retired - but only when the player cannot see it, so a duplicate never winks out of existence in front of the player.  Quota is hardcoded to 1 here; for a pair SCP, use two markers instead.

then.//: This one is the primary.  Claim it and stop counting.

else.//: Over quota.  Only retire if unobserved - a pop would break the fiction.
